question.text: Under Section 6(4) of SCRA, when an inquiry is undertaken, who is bound to produce books of accounts and documents before the inquiring authority?

answer.text: Only the directors of the stock exchange
Directors, managers, secretaries or other officers of the exchange, every member, partners or firm officers, and any person or body of persons who had direct or indirect dealings with them
Only the member of the stock exchange under inquiry
Only the compliance officer of the stock exchange

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 6(4) casts a wide net requiring every director, manager, secretary or other officer of the stock exchange; every member; every partner, manager, secretary or officer of a member firm; and every other person or body of persons who had direct or indirect dealings with them to produce books of accounts and documents before the inquiring authority. The Trap: Limiting it to only directors or only the member under inquiry ignores the broad scope of Section 6(4), which extends to secretaries, other officers, and even bodies of persons with dealings. Note: Read Section 6(4) as a wide net covering exchange officers, members, member-firm partners and officers, and any person or body of persons with direct or indirect dealings.
